content: Loud Whisper base their approach on BIBREF9 which is a graph-based sense clustering model. They process the data set to receive bigrams, create a co-occurence graph representation and after clustering assess the type of change per word by comparing the results against an intersection table. Their motivation is not only to use a graph-based approach, but to extend the approach by enabling change detection for all parts of speech as opposed to the original model.
